blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Brighouse South is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 163 homes sold there: 121 condos and 42 townhomes. 121 condos sold in Brighouse South with a median price of $535,000 (the middle half sold between $450,000 and $610,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 2% sold above list.
Brighouse South home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

121 condos sold in Brighouse South with a median price of $535,000 (the middle half sold between $450,000 and $610,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $552 per square foot, a median year built of 1991 and a median strata fee of $482 a month. 42 townhomes sold in Brighouse South with a median price of $885,250 (the middle half sold between $792,500 and $953,750), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $581 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median strata fee of $421 a month.

faq.q: What did condos in Brighouse South sell for?
faq.a: 121 condos sold in Brighouse South between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $535,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Brighouse South?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.4% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Brighouse South sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 121 condos that sold in Brighouse South went for between $450,000 and $610,000, around a median of $535,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Brighouse South sell above asking price?
faq.a: 2% of the 121 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.4% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Brighouse South?
faq.a: Of the 121 sales, 121 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $482.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Brighouse South?
faq.a: The median year built was 1991 for the 121 condos sold in Brighouse South.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Brighouse South usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Brighouse South had 2 bedrooms, from the 121 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Richmond?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
